Proposal Name
bp Cherry Point Advance Mitigation Project 5
Proposal Description
bp Cherry Point proposes to create a 230.68 acre advanced mitigation site north of the Cherry Point Refinery, between Jackson Road and a spur of the BNSF Railway right-of-way. The site will consist of two non-adjoining areas.
Related Record
Location
Address: Blaine, WA 98230
Parcel: 390105038276, 390106101468, 390105370331, 390105360427, 390105213316, 390105403340, 390105389141, 390105038316, 390105213366, 390106211210, 390105305332, 390105194083, 390106196461, 390106069346, 390105080191, 390105356140
Section/Township/Range: Sections 5 and 6, Township 39 North, Range 01 East, W.M.
Other identifying information: Multiple parcels between Jackson Road and a spur of the BNSF Railway Right-of-Way. The Project areas are located north of Grandview Road (SR 548), south of Bay Road, east of Jackson Road, and west of Kickerville Road. Area 5A is a 156.73-acre undeveloped area within Section 5, Township 39 North, Range 01 East, W.M. More specifically, the area is bounded by Blaine Road to the west, privately-owned residential and undeveloped properties to the north, Terrell Creek to the south, and the BNSF right-of-way to the east. Area 5B is a 73.95-acre undeveloped area within Section 6, Township 39 North, Range 01 East, W.M. The area is located southeast of the intersection of Jackson Road and Bay Road, and is bounded by Jackson Road to the west, Bay Road to the north, Terrell Creek to the south, and undeveloped properties to the east.
